'''2000 Seattle Grand Slam Douglas Harvilla DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Seattle Grand Slam]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Harvilla DS 2000 Seattle.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Dark Side Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi Deck

Deadly and effective at the Star Wars CCG Championship at the Seattle Grand Slam. Doug Harvilla rode this weapon of destruction all the way to the Winner's Circle.
